title: Smoky Black Pudding Namul
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Korean namul, with a smoky black pudding kick.

ingredients.name: Black Pudding
ingredients.notes: Vegetarian black pudding or Korean-style black bean paste

ingredients.name: Namul Greens
ingredients.notes: Seasonal greens such as spinach, kale, or collard greens

instructions: 1. Cut the namul greens into manageable pieces.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang, gochugaru, and sesame oil to make the dressing.
3. Add the chopped cucumber to the bowl and toss to combine.
4. In a separate pan, cook the black pudding over medium heat until crispy.
5. Add the cooked black pudding to the bowl and toss to combine.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
7. Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
8. Serve the smoky black pudding namul as a snack or side dish.
